findings.title: Thin pass breaks on new seeds: KE >14.9 J in 4 and separation >50 m in 2 of the extra tail-band runs (worst 16.05 J, 54.9 m)
findings.detail: The 48-case grid uses only three wind-estimate bias draws (bias seeded by the case seed: s11 +0.82, s12 −0.55, s13 +0.18 m/s downslope). Seed 15 draws −0.92 m/s (tail wind under-estimated): tail5.5_s15 is launched (estimate 5.07), CL saturates at CLmax 4.98 % of the airborne time, KE 15.034 J, separation 54.9 m, ops 3, avail 49 %; tail6_s15 KE 14.09 J, ops 3. Seeds 14–16 ensemble: avail 84.371 %, jitter p90 2.447, setup p90 24.17 — the means survive, the safety maxima do not. Bias ±2 m/s on the 48 grid → KE 17.919 J. Tail 4.5–6 × seeds 17–22 (six more bias draws): KE 16.052 J max, 8/24 refused, ops 3 in 4. Over all extra tail-band flown runs (n=24) the KE/C0 lines are crossed in: tail5.5_s15 15.034 J / 54.864 m, tail6_s17 16.052 J / 38.368 m, tail5.5_s20 15.49 J / 42.153 m, tail6_s21 14.939 J / 50.538 m. Mechanism: the gate admits estimated downslope wind up to ≈6 m/s, i.e. true tail 5.5–6 m/s in turbulence (σ 0.15–0.2 U) — at the physical limit w_max ≈6.1 m/s of the extended wing — and in those runs the limiter/air brake/land-now do not hold 14.9 J. Not only under-reading: s17 under-reads 0.24 (tail6, 16.05 J), s20 OVER-reads (tail5.5, est. 5.96, 15.49 J). All four are 'left behind' runs (ops 3). On the judged grid the same band gave ≤13.75 J only because of the three bias draws.

findings.title: 'LisHawk-style' morph exceeds the cited data: +100 % wing area / +82 % span vs Ajanic 2020 +41 % wing (+60 % wing+tail) by sweep, and one 2.5 g servo vs LisHawk's 7.1 g servos
findings.detail: Ajanic et al. 2020 (Sci. Robot. 5:eabc2897, Tab. 1): wing 0.117→0.165 m² (+41 %) by wrist SWEEP (feathers fan), tail 0.014→0.044 m²; 284 g; three BMS-306 servos 7.1 g / 2.0 kg·cm (one per wing side + tail). The 4.0 m/s minimum is a trim optimisation from static wind-tunnel data INCLUDING thrust at α>20° (implied CL ≈1.6 on 0.179 m² at ρ 1.2, ≈1.4 on 0.209 m²), not a demonstrated glide; tucked 7.6 m/s is a trim limit (CL≈0.6). leapfrog: 0.05→0.10 m² (+100 %) by spanwise sliding feathers (0.55→1.0 m), a different mechanism, CLmax 1.25 ASSUMED at Re ≈34 k (extended chord 0.10 m at 5.1–5.7 m/s, ν 1.67e-5) — optimistic but not impossible for a cambered thin wing; 3-D AR-10 feathered wing with gaps unproven. One 2.5 g micro servo extends the feathers under load AND folds the wings. LisHawk-class actuation (+2×7.1 g −2.5 g, ×1.15) ≈ +13.5 g → 182 g; mass is the most sensitive parameter (KE cap). Dev sensitivities: Sx 0.085 → separation 53.7 m; CLmax 1.1 → 50.4 m.
findings.evidence: arXiv 2002.02421 (Ajanic et al.) Tab. 1, wind-tunnel and morphing-optimisation sections; model.js BOM_R4/PDEF; audit4 out_r4_mass8/mass10/clmax1p1

findings.title: avail margin (2.3 pp) depends on mass and CLmax: +8–10 % mass or CLmax 1.1 fails
findings.detail: Full 48-case re-runs (auditor): mass +10 % (0.185 kg, cap re-derived) → avail 67.695 %, KE 13.787, sep 47.867; mass 0.182 kg → 71.91 %; extended CLmax 1.1 → 78.016 %, sep 49.913 m. Mass 0.182 kg also breaks the C0 radius (58.364 m). The KE cap (√(2·14.9/m)) ≈ the rider's straight-line speed, so every gram costs footage.

findings.title: Live tracker: latency compensation and feed-forward use the true LOS; with a 1 Hz GNSS velocity link jitter p90 3.43 °/s and avail 64.6 % fail
findings.detail: analysis.js: detections = true LOS rotated by 3 % box noise + 3 % pose bias (15 Hz, 80 ms) — acceptable error model; but the latency compensation adds the TRUE LOS increment (los[i]−los[j]) and the feed-forward is the true LOS rate 0.1 s old + σ0.3 m/s GM velocity error every 20 ms (no GNSS update rate, no phone/tag GNSS latency beyond 0.1 s). Auditor variants on a copy: estimated latency compensation + 5 Hz GNSS → jitter p90 2.013, avail 82.092; 1 Hz GNSS σ0.5 m/s → p90 3.43, avail 64.611. Turret pointing in model.js likewise = true rider mid + Gauss–Markov UWB/GNSS/vision error with TRUE rider velocity for prediction. The vision detection test uses the true subject position (probability 0.9).
findings.evidence: sim/js/concepts/leapfrog/analysis.js L100–135; model.js L905–945; audit4 out_r4_tracker*.json (patched copy copy_lfsens)

findings.title: Guidance and airspeed control use true rider state and true airspeed; point-mass model cannot stall
findings.detail: runCore guidance (gap, sepNow, lane, vsx, separation give-up/land) uses the TRUE rider position/velocity (GNSS rel. error σ1.5 m not applied to guidance); the airspeed floor/CL command uses the TRUE air vector (pitot noise only enters the gust interlock); CL is clamped at CLmax — no stall break, no lift loss, no departure. Stall probe: judged-grid min Va/v_stall 0.99–1.14 with ≤0.6 % of airborne time above 95 % CLmax; seed-15 tail cases spend 5–8 % of airborne time at the CL clamp with Va < v_stall. The in-flight air-data wind is true local wind + the shared bias, 2 s low-pass (no airspeed/sideslip error). Wind gates do use windEstimate() with ≥5 s history (verified gateHist 5.0 in every case).

safetyRegulatory: EU C0 follow-me 50 m: grid max 39.9 m, but 54.9 m on seed 15 tail5.5 (bias-dependent)
KE ≤14.9 J not robust for true tail 5.5–6 m/s (16.05 J tail6_s17, 15.49 tail5.5_s20, 15.03 tail5.5_s15, 14.94 tail6_s21); robust for true tail ≲5 m/s
Free-flying 168 g aircraft over a piste: resort permission and bystander exposure (0.15–1.5 near passes per run after avoidance, ASSUMED densities)
No tether, no worn boom: headClear ≥2.0 m robust
credibleEnvelope: Simulation-credible on groomed, low-traffic pistes in calm/cross/head wind ≤9 m/s and true tail wind ≲5 m/s, rider downhill progress ≲11 m/s, and only if: the feathered wing reaches CLmax ≥1.2 at +100 % area, the airframe stays ≤≈172 g, the launch gate is tightened to ≈5 m/s estimated downslope wind (costing tail-band avail; not re-judged), and the rider tag provides ≥5 Hz GNSS velocity to the framing tracker.
verdict: Reproduces exactly (48/48) and passes all 13 metrics as modelled (avail 82.462, jitter p90 1.635, setup p90 24.72, ops p90 2, KE 13.748 J, headClear 2.012 m, endurance 52.95 min, 2.50 L). The pass is thin: new seeds keep the means but break the safety maxima (KE up to 16.05 J in 4 extra tail-band runs, 54.9 m > C0 50 m); avail fails at +8–10 % mass or CLmax 1.1; the enabling morphing wing goes beyond the cited LisHawk data. Verdict: conditional pass — most credible 'usable in simulation' candidate inside a light-tailwind envelope, not demonstrated.
